text: Refund policy update 2021 allows refunds within 30 days.
Refund policy update 2024 allows refunds within 7 days.
Product release notes 2020 include the classic dashboard.
Product release notes 2024 include the new analytics dashboard.
Pricing guide 2022 lists the pro plan at 49 dollars.
Pricing guide 2025 lists the pro plan at 79 dollars.
Security policy 2022 requires monthly key rotation.
Security policy 2025 requires weekly key rotation.
Billing FAQ 2020 describes annual invoice process.
Billing FAQ 2024 describes self-serve invoice downloads.
On-call runbook 2021 says escalation starts at severity one.
On-call runbook 2024 adds severity two auto-paging.
API limits 2019 cap requests at 100 per minute.
API limits 2024 cap requests at 300 per minute.
Data retention policy 2022 keeps logs for 30 days.
Data retention policy 2025 keeps logs for 90 days.
Support SLA 2021 target first response in 24 hours.
Support SLA 2024 target first response in 4 hours.
Incident postmortem process 2020 emphasizes weekly review.
Incident postmortem process 2024 emphasizes 24 hour review.
